column1: # Narration for the demo, one line per row, pipe separated:
#   <second on the cut's timeline>|<words>
# Starts are placed against the measured page map from verify_cut.sh, not against the arithmetic in
# build_cut.sh:
#     0.0 -  4.5  the landing page
#     4.5 - 12.5  the overview
#    12.5 - 18.5  the case list
#    18.5 - 32.5  run a case
#    32.5 - 40.0  prove a price
#    40.5 - 44.0  the landing page, closing
# Numbers are spelled as they are spoken, there is no marketing vocabulary, and every claim is one
# the viewer can check on screen in the same shot. Only rows that begin with a digit are read.
# Length matters: this voice runs about 16 characters a second, and build_narration.sh refuses to
# build a track whose line outlasts the segment it is talking about.
0.3|A liquidation pays out on the feed's price.
5.2|One block read: the bond against the requirement, and the bonuses still held.
12.7|Six cases here, three of them caught lies.
19.2|The feed prints the real price, then twenty percent low; the contract computes the gap.
27.8|That gap is what a challenge stakes on.
33.4|Anyone can challenge a case, no account needed.
37.4|Read beside the verdict recorded on chain.
40.6|Prices you can check, and a record you can read.
